Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules associated with document CHEMBL3044971. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3044971'. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical_smiles is available. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
